Resolves #20264

Evidence: E1 — `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/Workspace.spec.mjs -g "Workstation statusModule seam"` (`1 passed (2.1s)`)

## Summary

Adds a `statusModule` class config to `Workstation.view.Workspace` (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`) so a Workstation subclass or workspace config can supply its own status readout component in the `.workstation-controls` row without overriding `construct()` or mutating `StatusComponent.prototype`:

- **`Workstation.view.Workspace#statusModule` (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`):** Defaults to `StatusComponent`, documented in the `ViewportController#workspaceModule` style (`#20223`).
- **Controls row composition (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`):** `construct()` builds the status readout from `{module: me.statusModule, flex: 1}`.
- **Unit spec (`test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/Workspace.spec.mjs`):** Verifies that `Workspace.prototype.statusModule` defaults to `StatusComponent`, and that a `Workspace` subclass or config object naming a custom readout module creates an instance of that class in the controls row.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Command / Artifact | Result |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1: `Workstation.view.Workspace` has a `statusModule` class config defaulting to `StatusComponent` and documented like `workspaceModule` | `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs` lines 107-113 | `statusModule: StatusComponent` added to `static config` with JSDoc |
| AC-2: The controls row creates its readout from `statusModule`; default readout is unchanged | `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs` line 275 + `Workspace.spec.mjs` (`#20264` arm) | `defaultWorkspace.items[1].items[0]` is an instance of `StatusComponent` |
| AC-3: A unit spec shows a subclass or config naming its own module gets an instance of that class in the controls row | `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/Workspace.spec.mjs -g "Workstation statusModule seam"` | `subWorkspace.items[1].items[0]` and `configWorkspace.items[1].items[0]` are instances of `CustomStatus` (`1 passed (2.1s)`) |

## Deltas

- **Scope:** Matches `#20264` (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/Workspace.spec.mjs`).
- **Contract Ledger:** No drift from `#20264`.
- **Avoided Traps:** No `construct` override, no `StatusComponent.prototype` mutation, and no `createControls()` array-index seam.
